sketches.mechanism: Recursive bindings plus non-strict evaluation allow a definition with any type that only diverges when demanded.
sketches.resonance: It can be anything because it never has to become anything.

sketches.mechanism: An empty variant type has no constructors, and a refutation case lets the type checker accept a match whose branch is unreachable.
sketches.resonance: The reply is complete because the caller can never arrive.

sketches.mechanism: Assigning nil to a table field removes that key, and reading an absent key yields nil.
sketches.resonance: The only way to place nothing somewhere is to make the somewhere disappear.
